written_before: any fit on D_sensor_train and before D_sensor_confirm was ever read
state: clean P0 residual, padding-safe last valid prompt token, no intervention
family: L2-regularized linear logistic probe (full residual space)
why_linear_only: The sensor must keep a transparent residual-space distance certificate: Theorem S needs d(h) to be an affine function of h.

sample_size_disclosure.note: n << d, so the probe is strongly underdetermined and leans entirely on the L2 penalty. This is disclosed in advance; the confirmatory gate is evaluated on held-out data, and training accuracy is never used as evidence.

GATE.boundary: d(h)=0 by construction; no post-hoc tau is estimated
